name: Vapi HR Bewerberprotokoll an Slack (Prod v3)

parameters.content:
## Vapi HR Workflow (Prod v3)

- Webhook antwortet sofort (onReceived)
- Filtert NUR end-of-call-report (kein Spam, keine LLM-Kosten fuer Zwischen-Events)
- Robustes JSON-Parsing (entfernt Codebloecke)
- Slack & OpenRouter via env

Vapi-URL: https://<N8N_HOST>/webhook/vapi-call-ended
